title: Nobody could ever have too many tomatoes
author: Radu Mureșan
body:
In August her hallway was full of tomatoes. Crates of them, along both walls, so you had to turn sideways to get to the kitchen door. She gave them away to anyone who came past and she never once accepted money.

The rule was: you may refuse a tomato, but you may not refuse twice.

My daughter was seven the first time she came home with a bag of them and asked me who the tomato lady was. Last summer, twenty-two years later, she took her own daughter to that hallway. Maria was too tired by then to stand for long, but she had put two crates out anyway.
